title: GeneratedMCPServerPackage.oauthConfig
description: Contract for the runtime OAuth configuration shipped in a Generated MCP Server Package (FR-014, FR-016). Contains no secrets: authorization is completed interactively at serve-time (research.md #3), and resulting tokens live only in a RuntimeAuthSession per the storage contract, never in this config.

clientId.description: Public OAuth client identifier; never a client secret.

redirectMode.description: loopback: local stdio serve mode opens a system browser to a 127.0.0.1 callback. hosted: streamable-http serve mode uses the configured public redirect URI (FR-016).

hostedRedirectUri.description: Required when redirectMode is 'hosted'; unused otherwise.

scopes.description: Minimum scopes needed to call the tools included in this package.

fallback.description: Documented fallback for webapps that do not support OAuth (spec edge case).
